tilecountMismatch.body: This level's chart has {{tilecount}} achievable tiles. Your total judgements add up to {{hitSum}}. These values might be wrong.

tagWarnings.title: Please confirm these level requirements
tagWarnings.keyLimit: This level requires to be beaten with at most {{count}} keys.
tagWarnings.overlapAllowed: This level allows overlapping keys. Confirm you stayed within the allowed overlap.
tagWarnings.twoHandPseudos: This level restricts 2-hand pseudos. Confirm you followed the allowed key usage.
tagWarnings.onhandOffhandLimit: This level has an onhand/offhand limit. Confirm you followed the allowed key usage.
tagWarnings.variableKeyLimit: This level has a variable key limit. Confirm you followed the key limit in each section.
tagWarnings.noLargeKeys: This level does not allow large keys.
tagWarnings.feetOnly: This level requires to be beaten with feet only.
tagWarnings.fourKeyBaseLimit: This level has a 4-key base limit. Confirm you followed the allowed key usage.
tagWarnings.twoKeyBaseLimit: This level has a 2-key base limit. Confirm you followed the allowed key usage.
tagWarnings.freeRoam: This level includes Free Roam. Complete it as intended.
tagWarnings.multiTrack: This level has a multi-track gimmick. Play the intended tracks.
tagWarnings.math: This level has a math gimmick. Complete it as intended.
tagWarnings.rpg: This level has an RPG gimmick. Play it as intended.
tagWarnings.memorization: This level has a memorization gimmick. It should be beaten with full VFX.
tagWarnings.unorthodoxReading: This level has unorthodox reading. Play it with the intended visuals.
tagWarnings.arrowKey: This level is intended to be played with arrow keys.
tagWarnings.cameraRequired: This level requires camera. It should be beaten with the intended camera/VFX.
tagWarnings.autoTile: This level includes auto tiles. Be careful and re-check the judgements before submitting.
tagWarnings.judgementLimit: This level has a judgement limit. Confirm the required judgement setting matches your replay.
tagWarnings.hpBar: This level uses an HP bar. Confirm you played with the required HP bar setting.
tagWarnings.detailedJudgement: This level requires detailed judgement. Confirm the judgement display matches the requirement.
tagWarnings.timingWindowScale: This level uses a scaled timing window. Confirm you played with the required timing window.
